new_statement: Under the hypotheses of node 1, make its real/complex convention explicit as follows. Let E_m=R^m be the ordered real space in def-stochastic and let C_m=C^m be its complexification. Every occurrence of l_inf^m in a UCP, completely bounded, matrix-algebra, or *-isomorphism expression is C_m; Q there is the complex-linear extension Q_C of the real row-stochastic Q; D_C:M_n(C)->C_n is diagonal extraction and J_C:C_n->M_n(C) is diagonal inclusion. The final positive-unital maps and inf-to-inf estimates are the restrictions to the self-adjoint real parts E_k and E_n. Put epsilon=K*eta. Then 0<=epsilon<=1/24; Delta and Upsilon are completely contractive; D_C and J_C are UCP contractions with D_C J_C=I; Phi=J_C Q_C D_C is UCP with diagonal range, D_C Phi=Q_C D_C, and ||Phi||_cb<=1.
